description_evaluated: Plan and build a structured multi-frame Replit canvas presentation board — hero rows, labeled zones, iframe lifecycle (building→live), coordinate layouts, and focusCanvasShapes for audience navigation. Use when organising the canvas for a designathon, showcase, or any multi-frame review. Also activate for "arrange the frames", "set up the board", "label the zones", "focus the viewport", or any canvas layout that needs deliberate spatial planning rather than ad-hoc placement.

queries.rationale: Matches 'arrange the frames' and 'label the zones' for a multi-frame review — squarely within described intent.

method: Each query was evaluated strictly against the skill description only, without reference to the skill body or outside assumptions. A query was marked triggered only when its intent fell within the description's stated scope (multi-frame canvas presentation-board planning, hero rows, labeled zones, iframe building→live lifecycle, coordinate layouts, focusCanvasShapes/viewport focus, and its explicit trigger phrases), not merely for sharing a keyword such as 'canvas', 'frame', or 'arrange'. Confusion-matrix counts were tallied and recall/precision computed, then compared against the release thresholds to determine pass/fail.
